tolerances.implementation_comparison: np.allclose rtol=3e-10, atol=3e-10; report actual maximum absolute errors
tolerances.conditioned_whole_PSD: min symmetric eigenvalue >= -3e-10; exact observed zero rows/columns; fresh unobserved block Cholesky
tolerances.quadrature_Jensen: fixed GH KG and IVR >= -1e-12; tiny signed residual preserved, no clipping
tolerances.continuous_KG_diagnostic: exact1D envelope or outer scipy.quad epsabs=epsrel=2e-9, limit150; continuous KG >= -3e-9; report estimate and GH bias without declaring rule-integration bias an implementation failure
tolerances.CRPS_reference: independent scipy.quad CDF-integral epsabs=1e-11, compared using implementation tolerance

failure_policy: Preserve every family outcome and source hashes in a unique output. Report failures to root; do not silently edit producer, retune or re-execute a changed harness. Root must classify harness-only errors versus producer errors and authorize any amendment before continuation.
scientific_limits: bounded mathematical and role-contract audit only
not novelty or top-conference readiness proof
